school.name: Academy of Urban Planning and Engineering, The
school.overview: Our school aims to empower a community of diverse advocates. Students will gain the skills and support needed to not only understand the world as it is but also to advocate for the world as it can be. At AUPE, educators work together to focus academic and socio-emotional instruction directly on students. The faculty is dedicated to providing challenging and relevant curriculum and teaching methods that encourage critical conversations and foster curious and responsive learners. As a Career Readiness and Modern Youth Apprenticeship (CRMYA) school, we prioritize preparing all students for their future careers. Ninth and tenth graders have the opportunity to explore their career interests and develop essential skills. Students can apply for apprenticeships in technology, finance, and business, allowing them to both earn and learn during their high school years. Additionally, as a FutureReadyNYC school, we offer a new career pathway in technology with courses ranging from Coding to Software Engineering. We are part of the Career Readiness and Modern Youth Apprenticeship (CRMYA) pilot, which helps us support career readiness for all our students. We have courses that help our ninth and tenth graders explore their career interests and develop readiness skills. Our students can apply for apprenticeships in tech, finance, and business, which allows them to earn and learn while in high school.

programs.name: Urban Planning, Engineering and Future Ready School (K52A)
programs.description: We engage with our students in urban planning through our housing rights public policy initiative in collaboration with out community partners. Students are also exposed to Robotics after school and in our Engineering courses. Our school competes in the FRC. All of our students are enroll in Creative Engineering I and II in 9th and 10th graders. Students who are interested in debate and public policy join our Model UN Club and travel the country to compete.
